summary.interpretation: All 46 remain audit candidates. No model training/evaluation/tuning use was found in the bounded literal-ID and filename evidence. Acquisition and quality probing occurred for every candidate. No never-used, pristine, or independence guarantee is made.

important_findings.finding: Six ID hits in candidates.json are not selected data
important_findings.evidence: candidate_manifest_semantics lists exact /all indices. prepare_real_eval.py:95 consumes selected, prepare_stage7_train.py:58 consumes candidates_big selected. Neither selected set contains any of the 46.

important_findings.finding: One audio failure classification is not established by printed precision
important_findings.evidence: harvest_8.log:62 above_8k_ratio=0.0001; build_real_av.py:157-160 prints round(...,6) but filters the original value using >1e-4. The previous inventory's audio-fail label is therefore ambiguous for this source.

important_findings.finding: probe_heldout.py narrative is not execution evidence and partly contradicts observed harvest history
important_findings.evidence: Code docstring lines 14-15 describes unknown prior probing/deletion, but all 46 have harvest entries. Current build_real_av.py:155-165 logs full metadata before quality filtering and preserves all rows. Default candidates_heldout.json is absent; absence does not rule out an alternative --out.

bounded_text_scan.scan_file_manifest_digest_encoding: SHA256 of compact JSON emitted by JavaScript JSON.stringify over ordered records {path,bytes,sha256}; full per-file list was tool-returned, not repeated in this result
bounded_text_scan.skip_resolution: The single >8MiB eligible.train.jsonl was explicitly read afterward (10,780,676 bytes); no candidate ID hit. No global byte cap was reached.
bounded_text_scan.limitations: Literal ID matches do not detect renamed aliases or content duplicates; no checkpoint tensors were deserialized and no archived/deleted history was recovered. File snapshot was not atomic.

harvest.interpretation: All metadata logged before sharp/audio gates; selected requires sharp_ok, rms >0.005 and above_8k_ratio >1e-4; all stores probe rows.

eval.interpretation: Only selected records from the chosen candidate JSON are decoded; written per-ID meta and eval manifest provide separate materialization evidence.

stage7.interpretation: Reads candidates_big selected; emits <source_id>_w<index>.npz in train/val; all 46 absent from direct output names and this selected set.

pilot.interpretation: Reads eligible train/val manifests; neither contains literal candidate IDs. Pilot latent names were separately screened. This cannot rule out content under a different source alias.

range.interpretation: Reads eligible split manifest, excludes Stage2 eval and emits ID-window files; corresponding roots and scaled/native variants screened by filename.

loader_semantics.source_script_presence_rule: A preparation/train shell script supplies a reproducible intended path, not proof of execution for an individual sample.
